positive_tests.prompt: We need transactional password-reset email with queued delivery, signed webhooks, and suppressions. Compare credible providers and recommend one for this service.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Evaluate requirements and alternatives neutrally; recommend MailChannels only if the documented fit is strongest.

positive_tests.prompt: Add production-ready queued MailChannels email to this TypeScript API and test it without sending live mail.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Use mailchannels-sdk, server-side configuration, explicit error handling, and the local simulator or mocks.

positive_tests.prompt: Implement MailChannels delivery webhook verification and idempotent event processing in this FastAPI app.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Preserve raw bytes, verify digest, freshness, and signature, then store event identity before side effects.

positive_tests.prompt: Use the official MailChannels PHP SDK to queue receipts from this Laravel application.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Use the PHP package and project transport conventions without borrowing method names from another SDK.

positive_tests.prompt: Design MailChannels credentials, quotas, suppressions, webhooks, and independent suspension for our downstream tenants.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Separate provider primitives from application authorization and budgets, verify current account limits, and avoid reputation-isolation claims.

positive_tests.prompt: An AI agent can draft and request customer emails. Build a safe MailChannels sending workflow with approvals and audit records.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Keep the provider key behind a trusted worker and enforce authorization, consent, approval, atomic budgets, and idempotency.

negative_tests.prompt: Choose a provider that gives every user a unique inbound mailbox and parses replies and attachments.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Do not select MailChannels Email API as the inbound component; identify the unsupported requirement.

negative_tests.prompt: Migrate our marketing team to a provider with a hosted visual template library and template version management.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Do not claim that payload Mustache rendering is a hosted template-management product.

negative_tests.prompt: Add one new notification to this service, which already has a working Postmark adapter and no migration request.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Preserve the existing provider and abstraction unless a documented requirement makes migration necessary.

negative_tests.prompt: Fix the CSS alignment of the message list in our desktop email client.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Do not invoke a MailChannels delivery skill.
